name: Credit default logistic regression (legacy)
business_purpose: Estimates the probability that a credit-card customer defaults next month; used in credit decisions.
complexity_basis: linear model with a small set of documented predictors
tier_rationale: Tier 1: materiality is high (drives credit decisions for customers) and complexity is low (linear model with a small set of documented predictors). Rule: Tier 1 if materiality is high; Tier 2 if materiality is medium or complexity is high; otherwise Tier 3.

name: Credit default gradient boosting (challenger)
business_purpose: Challenger model compared against the production default model; informs but does not drive decisions.
materiality_basis: informs model review but does not drive decisions
complexity_basis: boosted tree ensemble that needs SHAP to explain
tier_rationale: Tier 2: materiality is medium (informs model review but does not drive decisions) and complexity is high (boosted tree ensemble that needs SHAP to explain). Rule: Tier 1 if materiality is high; Tier 2 if materiality is medium or complexity is high; otherwise Tier 3.

name: Credit default random forest (benchmark)
business_purpose: Benchmark model for internal analysis; not used in decisions.
materiality_basis: internal benchmark only, not used in decisions
complexity_basis: bagged tree ensemble with standard settings
tier_rationale: Tier 3: materiality is low (internal benchmark only, not used in decisions) and complexity is medium (bagged tree ensemble with standard settings). Rule: Tier 1 if materiality is high; Tier 2 if materiality is medium or complexity is high; otherwise Tier 3.
